Definition: Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Zur = "rock"; 1) father of Cozbi and one of the 5 Midianite princes who were slain when Balaam fell; 2) son of Jehiel, the father or leader of Gibeon
